title: Figure 16: p-d (pressure vs interatomic distance) diagram for superexplosive compression
description: Small line plot captioned 'Figure 16. p-d, Pressure. Inneratomic distance diagram for the upper atomic and lower molecular adiabat.' Pressure p is plotted against distance d, with an upper adiabat a reaching critical pressure p_c at d_c and a lower adiabat b. Surrounding text presents equation (42) and describes a convergent shock-wave ignition scenario.
